description: tangram, an open platform for modular, real-time air traffic management research is a software deposit deposited in Figshare by its authors Xavier Olive, Junzi Sun (Delft University of Technology). tangram is an open research framework for ADS-B and Mode S flight surveillance data. Initially developed for turbulence detection research, it has since evolved into a versatile tool applicable to real-time aviation research topics, including GNSS jamming detection, aviation weather monitoring, emission analysis, and airport performance monitoring. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 11678628 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is GPL 3.0+. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
